summary: This is an 8-K filing by Patriot Gold Corp. reporting the board's approval of a 1-for-10 reverse stock split, subject to FINRA review and administrative processes. No definitive dates or prices are set. The filing describes the mechanics and effects of the split but does not involve a merger, acquisition tender, restructuring, or other special situation. It is a routine corporate action to adjust share price, not an event-driven special situation.
